payload.title: Images are served without touching the session and are always revalidated
payload.context: Images review (#25): a cached image opened for a day after sign-out, and image requests overwrote the session's previous URL.
payload.rationale: Media routes sit outside the web group behind a read-only session middleware, and answer with private, no-cache plus an ETag, so every view passes the access check and a 304 keeps it cheap.
payload.consequences: No cookie is set and no session is written by an image request.
